name: The Keeper
ins: The keeper calls his own by name, and the door will not answer him.
hint: The snake will chase you up the lane, but it will not step onto the exit. Let it follow you to the threshold and it will stop one cell short.

name: Separate Banks
ins: Two banks share one river, but never become one.
hint: A weight cannot climb back up, so choose its lower resting place carefully.

name: the honest stone
ins: The twin commits to the plate; it follows only where the floor allows, so choose a step it must refuse.
hint: Your twin repeats your every step. A bridge needs weight on its plate, so lead the twin into a pocket it cannot leave.

name: The Canonical Arch
ins: The canon feeds the echo; the echo never feeds the canon.
hint: Climb one tier at a time. The snake cannot follow even the first ledge.

name: The Queen of Venom
ins: The world moves only when you move.
hint: The queens converge behind you. Let the falling stones close their path, not yours.

name: The Unstamped Seal
ins: A hash by itself does not prove when.
hint: One crank remembers for both rivers. The gem's brittle detour has a lower way out.

name: out of phase
ins: Two patrols keep different clocks under one moon; the stone refuses odd strides and honors even ones, and a no left unexamined is a crossing skipped in silence.
hint: Each lizard advances one cell for every stride you take, each on its own beat; you cannot stand still, but stepping aside and back spends a beat. The spear judges only the parity of the stride you end on.

name: the mirror sentries
ins: Two keepers walk one road out of phase, each the other's mirror; the last door counts your steps and spares the even foot. An unexamined no is a silent skip.
hint: A keeper is most harmless just after it turns to walk away; count your steps onto the spear, for even feet are forgiven.

name: the scale: weight and shadow
ins: Two pans hang from one beam: set the stone and the door holds, but the shadow copies every step and the pit keeps what it is given.
hint: The bridge answers only to weight that stays. Climb the high lane and let the mirror trail you, for the hunter below counts every step you waste.

name: two swings, one fang
ins: It refused you on the odd beat, so you called the road closed; count the swing and the same fang is an open gate.
hint: Each lizard steps once after every step you take, swinging on a four beat pendulum. Enter a lane only while its rider is two squares away, and land on the fang only on an even count.

name: the charcoal weight
ins: Charcoal is free: draw the weight early, for the fang keeps strict hours and the mirror copies every line you make.
hint: The scale tips only while both pans are placed in time; your reflection is denied by stone, not by distance.

name: Below the Shrine
ins: Reach the shrine while the lizard patrols the lower lane.
hint: The fixed gem at [5,1] is on void, so it cannot be reached without changing the required base.

name: The Weight
ins: Some paths carry you only once.
hint: A weighted plate holds the bridge. Cracked stones offer a one-way detour with solid ground beyond.

name: stroke order
ins: Charcoal is free; stroke order is everything. The shadow waits in the dead end, the plate lights every bridge at once, and the critic can only cross where you have already crossed.
hint: Stop one step short of the bottom corner, then slip sideways while your shadow is denied by the void. One charcoal holds two bridges at once, even the gap caging the snake.

name: The Passing Guard
ins: The exit remains reachable, but the fixed gem at [5,1] lies on void and cannot be reached without changing the base.
hint: Watch the patrol's next position before taking each step.

name: the garnet pocket
ins: The bridge east only holds while the block rests on the plate, and two crumbling cells guard an optional gem pocket past it.
hint: Collapse cells fall the moment you step off them, so only commit to crumbling ground when the far side offers a way home; a pocket sealed on three sides can still open upward.

name: the barbed junction
ins: Spear traps flank the crank junction and judge only where a step ends; wake the crank to throw the bridge, then cross on a count that never ends odd on barbed floor.
hint: A spear kills only if a move ENDS on it at an odd step count, so an even arrival is safe. A stepped crank latches every bridge for good, and a retracted bridge is void to everyone.

name: Two Watchers
ins: Reach the exit while two snakes close in.
hint: The exit is ground that neither snake can enter.

name: The Offered Weight
ins: An offering opens a shorter road, but no offering is required.
hint: Push the block sideways onto the plate to open the bridge. The original route remains open.
